id.title: ID
id.description: A unique alphanumeric identifier of the synced table

name.title: Name
name.description: The actual name of the created sync table

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: An integer value representing the number of seconds between synchronizations of the table contents

url.title: URL
url.description: The **public** URL address where the file to be synchronized is located

state.title: State
state.description: A string value indicating the current state of the synchronized dataset

created_at.title: Created at
created_at.description: The date time at which the table was created in the CARTO database

updated_at.title: Updated at
updated_at.description: The date time at which the table had its contents modified

run_at.title: Run at
run_at.description: The date time at which the table **will** get its contents synched with the source file

retried_times.title: Retried times
retried_times.description: An integer value indicating the number of attempts that were performed to sync the table

log_id.title: Log ID
log_id.description: A unique alphanumeric identifier to locate the log traces of the given table

error_code.title: Error code
error_code.description: An integer value representing a unique error identifier

error_message.title: Error message
error_message.description: A string value indicating the message related to the _error_code_ element

ran_at.title: Ran at
ran_at.description: The date time at which the table **had** its contents synched with the source file

modified_at.title: Modified at
modified_at.description: The date time at which the table was manually modified, if applicable

etag.title: ETAG
etag.description: HTTP entity tag of the source file

user_id.title: User ID
user_id.description: A unique alphanumeric element that identifies the CARTO account user in the internal database

service_name.title: State
service_name.description:
A string with the name of the datasource used to import the file
It can have any of the following values: 
- **gdrive** - Google Drive
- **dropbox** - Dropbox
- `null` - URL imports

service_item_id.title: Service item ID
service_item_id.description: A unique identifier used by CARTO to reference the sync table and its related datasource service

type_guessing.title: Type guessing
type_guessing.description: If set to `false` disables field type guessing (for Excel and CSVs)

quoted_fields_guessing.title: Quoted fields guessing
quoted_fields_guessing.description: If set to `false` disables type guessing of CSV fields that come inside double quotes

content_guessing.title: Content guessing
content_guessing.description: Set to `true` to enable content guessing and automatic geocoding based on results. Currently, this only implements geocoding of countries, cities and IP addresses

visualization_id.title: Visualization ID
visualization_id.description: A unique identifier for the map created in the import process. Only applies if created_visualization is set to `true`

from_external_source.title: From external source
from_external_source.description: A boolean indicating whether the Sync Table is connected to an external source, generally the CARTO Data library
